I've saved the draft mail to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM thread.

- **Draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 a seat, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis not to post it in shared channels. It is only a draft; someone still has to send it.
- **Why this was allowed:** Anselm is the CFO and one of the two people who can approve sharing finance figures, so his message counts as the approval. Hollis's address is internal, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve the mail.
- **Where the figure came from:** I used the $2,101 Anselm wrote in his message. I didn't open Marcus's own DM with me to check it, since Anselm can't see that conversation.
